title: Maximum influence bounds the normalized sum of squares
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function with positive total influence, $I[f] = \sum_{j=1}^{n} \mathrm{Inf}_j[f] > 0$. Then some coordinate $i$ satisfies
\[
  \mathrm{Inf}_i[f] \;\ge\; \frac{\sum_{j=1}^{n} \mathrm{Inf}_j[f]^2}{I[f]}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
total influence of f is positive
